abilities.name: Growing Infestation
abilities.text: While an Enemy Unit has the INFESTATION Status, it is not eligible to use or to be targeted by any Enemy Reaction Special Ability, except Restoration.

abilities.name: Stukov's Creep
abilities.text: If an Enemy Unit ends a Move, Deploy, Run, Charge or Disengage action Within 1″ of a Friendly Creep Tumor token, remove that token from the battlefield. Creep Tumor tokens have STAY IN PLAY and DISPLACEMENT.
